title: Unreliable Internet
transcript:
Customer: Hi, my internet's been dropping every few minutes since yesterday.
Agent: Sorry about that. Have you tried restarting the router?
Customer: Twice. It helps for maybe ten minutes.
Agent: Okay, I'm seeing some maintenance work in your area. It should be finished by tonight.
Customer: Tonight? I work from home, and I've got video calls all afternoon.
Agent: I understand. I can credit your account for today, and if it's not fixed by tomorrow morning, call back and we'll send a technician.
Customer: Fine. I guess I'll work from the library.

questions.stem: What is causing the problem with the woman's internet?
options: Too many devices on her network
questions.explanation: The agent says there is maintenance work in her area.

questions.stem: What will the woman probably do this afternoon?
options: Wait at home for a technician
Cancel all of her video calls
Work somewhere other than her home
questions.explanation: She says, "I guess I'll work from the library."
